title: A hand around a branch
hook: A grasp uses more than a point of contact.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors suited to particular conditions.
doesNotKnow: The drawn digits wrap across the branch on more than one side. Grasping hands can help many primates hold and move along branches; hand structure and use vary by species. The sketch is not a force measurement.

misconception: A familiar animal behavior or structure must work in a different way.
objective: Which arrangement helps the pictured primate hand hold a branch?
